# URL prefixes the install scripts may download from.
# Add an entry only after reviewing the source. Prefer the narrowest prefix
# (a single repo, not all of github.com).

# Starship
https://starship.rs/install.sh

# Rust
https://sh.rustup.rs

# Zellij
https://api.github.com/repos/zellij-org/zellij/
https://github.com/zellij-org/zellij/releases/download/

# Node.js
https://nodejs.org/dist/index.json
https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_lts.x

# Lazygit / Lazydocker
https://api.github.com/repos/jesseduffield/lazygit/
https://github.com/jesseduffield/lazygit/releases/
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jesseduffield/lazydocker/master/scripts/install_update_linux.sh

# Neovim
https://github.com/neovim/neovim/releases/

# Oh My Zsh and plugins
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ohmyzsh/ohmyzsh/master/tools/install.sh
https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-autosuggestions
https://github.com/zsh-users/zsh-syntax-highlighting.git

# Nerd Fonts
https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts/releases/download/

# vim-plug
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/junegunn/vim-plug/master/plug.vim
